claims.summary: Amodei proposes slower frontier capability progress, permanent embedded independent evaluators, lab coordination and international cooperation.
Reuters reports Altman said OpenAI will adopt the embedded-evaluator principle and share more detail.
Altman told Fortune OpenAI will not go public in 2026 and linked timing to safety/alignment work.
CVE-2026-86793 describes an unauthenticated SGLang weight-update deserialization path when auth keys are not configured; SafeUnpickler can be bypassed via permitted builtins.
At review time the GitHub advisory listed affected/patched versions as unknown; VicOne reported no confirmed vendor patch at publication.

notes: Pacing language is not presented as a binding slowdown: no numerical limits or enforcement thresholds are public.

SGLang exploitability is scoped to deployments where the endpoint is reachable and authentication is not configured; no active exploitation claim is made.
GitHub Advisory is explicitly marked unreviewed; VicOne/CERT coordination provides additional technical evidence, but no patched version is asserted.
